Heinrich Luitpold Himmler ( German: [ˈhaɪnʁɪç ˈluːɪtpɔlt ˈhɪmlɐ] ⓘ ; 7 October 1900 – 23 May 1945) was a German Nazi politician and military leader. He was the 4th Reichsführer of the Schutzstaffel (Protection Squadron; SS) from 1929 to 1945. He was a leading member of the Nazi Party , and one of the most powerful figures in Nazi Germany . He was also one of the main architects of the Holocaust , the genocide of European Jews during World War II .
